scope: Read-only G07 reorg/replacement design guidance; not implementation or runtime acceptance
verdict: bounded local reorg feasible in source; explicit product recovery API and genuine acceptance remain required

findings.scenario: Confirmed preference loses canonical inclusion. Reconcile reports unknown and prepare remains fenced; lower replacement primitive is not exposed by Rolling.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit guarded preference-only recovery inspection, newly reviewed replacement draft and existing explicit fee-confirmed submission. Never clear journal or automatically recoverSaved while inspecting.

findings.scenario: Porting V5 replacement assumes saved applicationNullifier or treats Existing nullifier as proof the preference was absent. Rolling explicitly suppresses legacy extraction; error may concern a fee or other nullifier.
findings.recommendation: Do not fabricate attribution. Initial replacement availability only for exact all-attempt missing-anchor invalidity with repeated dropped receipts and fresh authenticated original revision/head. Existing-nullifier-only stays unresolved for separate canonical investigation, never automatic reproof.

supportedLifecycle: EthCheatCodes.reorgWithReplacement(depth,[]) uses real anvil_reorg at same L1 height. Compute depth against captured retained L1 boundary and verify all actual changed/retained hashes.

Keep current real-wall miner active while graceful sequencer.pause drains running iteration and pendingRequests; then await miner termination before paused-Anvil replacement. Do not substitute node.pauseSequencer minTx policy or force rollback.
execWithPausedAnvil restores in finally but catches restoration failures as warnings; require explicit actual automine and interval-mining readback after operation and cleanup.
Leave all funding/setup and retained root outside suffix; assert retained boundary at/after finalized and proven tips. Never mark target suffix finalized or use rollbackTo(force=true).
After replacement use one sequential parent miner and ordinary archiver/worldstate/PXE APIs; wait actual rollup archive/checkpoint, worldstate prune and PXE anchor/head convergence before reads.

Pool unmines pruned transactions and may restore pending. Anchor marker proof to deliberately disposable empty checkpoint, then verify actual default node.isValidTx says Block header not found and refreshed receipt remains dropped. No manual pool deletion/cache reset.

minimalAPI.inspection: Strictly read-only encrypted workflow+exact signed-attempt inspection; fixed canonical/pending/unknown/invalid-context states, preserve all prior hashes/bytes/inclusion facts. No acknowledgement, slot write, proof, submit or replacement authorization from inspection.
minimalAPI.prepareReplacement: Explicit user action for preference/read-marker only. Preserve workflow ID, operation, original expectedRevision and business action/nonce. Authenticate current head through ordinary synchronized private API. Preserve old attempt records; capture renewed head/marker canonical context and new fee ceiling in bounded AEAD CAS draft.
minimalAPI.submitPrepared: Explicit approval follows normal wallet lifecycle. Re-arm exact replacement authorization after restart; recheck every prior attempt before simulation/proof and again before send through read-only predecessor-only check. Existing rejectedAttempts cannot be used unchanged after prepare because it includes the new candidate.
minimalAPI.cancelReplacement: Return to retained recovery state; never erase signed history or reuse generic cancelPrepared to forget it.
minimalAPI.canonicalOtherAttempt: If an older attempt is now canonical, expose and explicitly reconcile that exact winner; do not acknowledge latest saved candidate or send it.

smallestSafetyArgument.basis: Unchanged original expectedRevision plus pinned v6 PrivateMutable uniqueness. Initialization nullifier hashes slot+owner+kernel-authenticated app NHK (embedded private_mutable.nr85-105,137-145); later updates consume unique existing head. next_revision checks exact revision. Two attempts at same original revision cannot both succeed in one canonical history.
smallestSafetyArgument.consequence: A new legacy execution-frame nullifier extractor or Noir ABI change is not necessary solely for the planned missing-anchor/same-revision recovery, provided implementation preserves these invariants and tests them. This is source reasoning, not a cryptographic audit.
smallestSafetyArgument.marker: Original throughBlock remains fixed; same-height new canonical hash is changed read context and requires explicit renewed review and pre-send check. Missing block or advanced head must not be silently substituted/rebased.
smallestSafetyArgument.nonceAlternative: An explicit secret-derived operation nonce/nullifier is a larger valid engineering option for broader replacement across changed revisions; it requires unambiguous domain/owner/scope/privacy design and full rebuilt ABI/VK/test/runtime evidence. Avoid introducing it solely to imitate a missing V5 attribution field.

genuinePrerequisites: Capture public retained R/L1 cut T, actual target Tx anchor X, proven/finalized tips and same-owner encrypted cache before reorg; all target suffix unfinalized.

Persist original canonical receipt/effect/fee before mutation; preserve historical inclusion separately from current noncanonical status. Current production L2 journal lacks historical receipt records, so explicit recovery transitions need bounded authenticated history rather than inventing lost facts.
Budget admission before reorg must reserve propagation, hot/cold reads, original writer settlement and cleanup under540seconds/4GiB; no timeout extension.

After actual L1 replacement verify archiver and worldstate convergence, ordinary PXE rollback of notes/events/tagging and reader epoch reset/full authenticated reconstruction; marker disappears with its own tx, so do not fabricate orphaned marker expectation.
Hot and reopened SAME encrypted journal/cache reads and optional fresh cache equal canonical retained state, with zero proof/send; new writes remain fenced until explicit recovery action.

For explicit replacement qualify initialization and already-initialized head paths, old reinclusion/pending/transport/CAS races, restart at every journal boundary, fee ceiling change and no late writer after close.

New proof accepted only via current normal API, one canonical preference transition, reorg-aware fee conservation (orphan fee removed from current sum), all immutable prior attempt evidence and cleanup retained.
limits: No tests/proofs/services/chain/network mutation performed by reviewer.
Same-height replacement alone is not proof archiver processed it; actual convergence is mandatory.
Current two-proof root+first-marker scenario covers initialization rollback, not existing-head replacement by itself.
Advanced-head and other invalidity recovery remain product work; legitimate unresolved classification must not be presented as final full recovery completion.
